## Project Introduction

For our Introduction to Engineering course at the University of Arkansas, our team programmed a robot to navigate an obstacle course. Our goal was to find an efficient path while reducing the time needed to complete the course and avoiding collisions.

## Project Objective

We wanted to improve how the robot moved through the course by comparing different paths and making changes based on the results of our tests.

## What We Did

- Programmed the robot to navigate an obstacle course.
- Compared different routes to see which worked most efficiently.
- Ran tests to evaluate how the robot performed.
- Adjusted the robot's movement program after reviewing the results.

## My Role

I helped lead the team and worked on improving our approach throughout the project. I also helped make adjustments based on what we learned during testing.

## What We Learned

This project gave us experience with programming, optimization, problem solving, and teamwork. It showed us how testing and small changes can improve how a process performs.
